svg.aria-label: Flowchart: how the AI-assisted QA process improves itself, as a treasure map. Illustrative drawing of the process, no data. The numbers are the order on the map.
svg.title: The improvement loop, as a treasure map

g.aria-label: the map itself is the project layer: context, knowledge and decisions that differ for every project
g.data-n: the map itself is the project layer: context, knowledge and decisions that differ for every project

g.aria-label: the trail: a loop. The last island leads back to the first, because every new miss is a new observation
g.data-n: the trail: a loop. The last island leads back to the first, because every new miss is a new observation

g.aria-label: 1 observe: a run, a CI failure or a miss is written down as a feedback entry. Nothing is judged yet
g.data-n: 1 observe: a run, a CI failure or a miss is written down as a feedback entry. Nothing is judged yet

g.aria-label: 2 analyze: AI groups the entries and looks for patterns. The result is a draft, not a finding
g.data-n: 2 analyze: AI groups the entries and looks for patterns. The result is a draft, not a finding

g.aria-label: 3 recommend: AI writes a change proposal: the exact old and new text, the reason and a candidate eval
g.data-n: 3 recommend: AI writes a change proposal: the exact old and new text, the reason and a candidate eval

g.aria-label: 4 approve: QA Lead approves or rejects any change to a rule, skill, hook or eval. Nothing is applied before this
g.data-n: 4 approve: QA Lead approves or rejects any change to a rule, skill, hook or eval. Nothing is applied before this

g.aria-label: 5 act: the approved change is applied, and only that change. Nothing else is touched along with it
g.data-n: 5 act: the approved change is applied, and only that change. Nothing else is touched along with it

g.aria-label: 6 audit: hooks, the validator and the run journal leave a trail, so a person can check what changed and why
g.data-n: 6 audit: hooks, the validator and the run journal leave a trail, so a person can check what changed and why

g.aria-label: 7 learn: lessons enter the knowledge base through intake. One source is one opinion until it is confirmed
g.data-n: 7 learn: lessons enter the knowledge base through intake. One source is one opinion until it is confirmed

g.aria-label: 8 evaluate: evals measure whether a skill or a hook works. A check that was not run is NOT RUN, never PASS
g.data-n: 8 evaluate: evals measure whether a skill or a hook works. A check that was not run is NOT RUN, never PASS

g.aria-label: 9 improve: the next version of the rule, skill or hook starts from this result. New misses go back to step 1
g.data-n: 9 improve: the next version of the rule, skill or hook starts from this result. New misses go back to step 1

g.aria-label: production: a skull rock off the route. No access, and nothing on this map goes there
g.data-n: production: a skull rock off the route. No access, and nothing on this map goes there
g.text: production:
no access

g.aria-label: the compass: rules, policy and permissions. It sits in the middle because every step is steered by it
g.data-n: the compass: rules, policy and permissions. It sits in the middle because every step is steered by it
g.text: rules, policy,
permissions
observe
analyze
recommend
approve
QA Lead
act
audit
learn

improve

g.aria-label: the pirate is the reviewer. He walks the trail, rests on every island, and waits longest at the red X until a person has decided
g.data-n: the pirate is the reviewer. He walks the trail, rests on every island, and waits longest at the red X until a person has decided

g.text: 1 observe: a run, a CI failure or a miss is written down
as a feedback entry. Nothing is judged yet.
2 analyze: AI groups the entries and looks for patterns.
The result is a draft, not a finding.
3 recommend: AI writes a change proposal: the exact old and
new text, the reason and a candidate eval.
4 approve: a person decides. QA Lead approves or rejects
any change to a rule, skill, hook or eval.
5 act: the approved change is applied, and only that one.
Nothing else is touched along with it.
6 audit: hooks, the validator and the run journal leave a trail,
so a person can check what changed and why.
7 learn: lessons enter the knowledge base through intake.
One source is one opinion until it is confirmed.
8 evaluate: evals measure whether a skill or a hook works.
A check that was not run is NOT RUN, never PASS.
9 improve: the next version starts from this result.
New misses go back to step 1.
